cc:Work.dc:title: Mapa metro Barcelona actual (Treni derivative)
cc:Work.dc:description: Derived from "Mapa metro Barcelona actual.svg" by ItsAstrid (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mapa_metro_Barcelona_actual.svg), revision of 16 June 2025, used under CC BY-SA 4.0. ItsAstrid is the file's sole author and derived it from the same author's "Mapa metro Barcelona futur.svg"; both describe themselves as based on the map designed by Jug Cerović and Martí Ruiz for ATM Barcelona. Modifications for the Treni app: station markers added; some line routes adjusted to improve the connections between lines; the line paths reorganised into one path per line and labelled with the app's line ids (L1-L12, L9N, L9S, L10N, L10S, T1-T6); elements the app does not use (text outlines, rivers, Rodalies and other decoration) hidden.
